pick.headline: Smart Knee Implant's Benefits Unproven, But Billing Connectivity Reported Excellent
pick.take: Researchers say the usefulness of these joints is unproven, yet insurers and Medicare reportedly still pay extra for them. The one reliably transmitted signal is revenue. Two patients allege they learned about their data-capable knees only after surgery, so informed consent apparently shipped without the firmware update.
